The witness, in the company of his father, a former airman flying in the air force, observes an object of metallic appearance, in the shape of a triangle. Note a nuclear power plant under construction 35 km from the observation site. Tours Air Base 55 km away. The object was still and in constant inclination.…
Observation reported to Valensole in 1965, studied by GEIPAN.

The witness, 15 years old at the time, and his brother observed, from the back of their car, a large, spilled plate in a lavender field. Children had come out of that plate. The witness refers to the Valensole case. He cannot precisely date his observation. Drawing requested.
